messages:
lina: quick PSA 1: our multilingual onboarding smoke (veridian-v1 -> int8) shows a weird split in CJK+emoji sequences causing dropped punctuation in translations. repro above threshold on zh->en and ja->en. example below.
hao: can you paste the raw input + tokenizer output?
lina: sure. small paste: 

```
INPUT: "44b3fb 1e81f3f4683ff4ac4dd今日本。"
TOKENIZER: ["\ud83d\udc4b\ud83c\udffd", " ", "\ud83c\uddef\ud83c\uddf3", "\ud83d\udc68\ud83c\udfff", "\ud83d\udcac", "\ud83d\udcdd", "今", "\u001f", "日本", "。"]
EXPECTED TOKENS: ["\ud83d\udc4b\ud83c\udffd", " ", "\ud83c\uddef\ud83c\uddf3\ud83d\udc68\ud83c\udfff", "\ud83d\udcac\ud83d\udcdd", "今日本", "。"]
OBS: stray U+001F char showing up as separate token, punctuation attached wrong.
```

sam: hmm that U+001F lookslike a control char sneaked in during preproc. did we change the emoji normalization in tokenization glue recently?
qa-bot: run=rloc-1129, model=veridian-v1-int8, dataset=emoji-locale-smoke, metrics={bleu:-0.45, sacrebleu:-0.47, drop_rate:0.03}, anomalies={control-char-tokens:12, emoji-sep:9} (see: https://ci.internal/rloc/1129)
hao: i didn't touch emoji rules but there was a tiny change to the pre-token normalization to strip nonprinting chars. looks like the strip now conflates variant selectors and regional indicators when combined with skin-tones.
lina: local quick-fix: re-enable keeping VARIATION SELECTOR-16 (U+FE0F) + regional indicator pair adjacency check; that fixes token merges in a quick smoke. i tested on 200 samples -> drop_rate->0.005.
sam: long-term we should add mixedscript+emoji unit in locale-suite and add a precommit sanitizer that rejects control bytes. also add a regression test comparing token id histograms between fp16 and int8 on a per-sentence basis (threshold 2%).
hao: i'll open a PR to revert the stripping and add sanitizer. linking draft: https://git.internal/tokenizer/pr/4672 (draft).
ops: staging alert: rolling back veridian-v1-int8 canary while fix lands. created incident I-2026-78 (ops)
qa-bot: note: when we reran with reverted strip, BLEU recovered to -0.08 on the smoke set. full eval pending.
lina: thanks! i'll collate sample failures into a ticket and attach minimal repros. tagging @sam to own test additions to locale-suite.
sam: on it, will add tests + perf gate. :rocket:
summary: emoji + mixed CJK sequences were split incorrectly after a preprocessing change for int8 onboarding; quick revert of control-char stripping recovers most BLEU; next steps: tokenizer revert PR, new unit tests in locale-suite, sanitizer and histogram regression checks
